notes: Accuracy: 25 seed-7 brands all shown on their src pages (0 wrong); but 22 of 25 rest on a bare listing (Wikipedia country list or category) that states no quality or cultural standing, so the 'cultural' layer is unsupported by the page itself for most of the 158 cultural entries. Scope: the 'Category:Radio manufacturers' batch (about 30 names) is broadcast radio/TV and belongs in D3 (see move); Stay in D2: Marconi (communications receivers), RadioShack (seller of Realistic scanners/CB; role seller), all 18 amateur-radio companies except Zetron, all smartwatch and e-book names. GRE (company) is recorded as Italy but is probably the Japanese scanner maker General Research of Electronics: check. Index tags: Starlink (index I3) should also carry D2 (Starlink Mini satellite hotspot is tested by OutdoorGearLab); Vestel (B5/B6) also makes D2 phones; Turkish Casper is a homonym of the B1 mattress brand; Lava (index H1) is a homonym of Lava International phones. Kinds file lists 'Car sat-nav' but the framework sends mounted sat-navs to G1. Thin areas retried: satellite messengers/PLBs (OutdoorGearLab, Switchback, Treeline): only Somewear new, Garmin/Zoleo/ACR/Ocean Signal/SPOT/Bivy(ACR) already known; walkie-talkies (OutdoorGearLab, Wirecutter, GearJunkie): all brands known (Rocky Talkie, BCA, Midland, Cobra, Baofeng, Motorola, Retevis); professional LMR added (Tait, Codan, GME, Hytera, Sepura). GLOMO 2011-2019 fetched (2016) and seen in search: device winners are all known except Well Being Digital. CES Innovation Awards 2026: OtterBox, Littlebird new. Fitness trackers: Hume Health new. Notebookcheck/GSMArena not retried (no new brands expected).
